title: Natural English or a typical mistake?
statement: Ці речення почуті на співбесідах. Визнач, яке звучить **природно**, а яке містить **типову помилку**. У поясненні до помилок — правильний варіант.

items.text: I reported twelve bugs and wrote fifteen test cases.
I have been learning Playwright for three months.
Could you clarify which browsers you support?
In my project, the tests run on GitHub Actions on every pull request.
It depends on the risk and the release date.
I'm not sure, but I think it's related to caching.
I have 3 years experience in sales.
items.explain: I have three years of experience in sales.

items.text: I am studying QA since January.
items.explain: I have been studying QA since January.

items.text: Can you explain me the task?
items.explain: Can you explain the task to me?

items.text: We discussed about this bug with the developer.
items.explain: We discussed this bug with the developer.

items.text: How it works in your team?
items.explain: How does it work in your team?

items.text: On the screenshot you can see the error.
items.explain: In the screenshot you can see the error.

items.text: I passed a QA course last year.
items.explain: I completed (took) a QA course last year.

hints: Перевір прийменники (depends on, in the screenshot), часи (have been … since) і конструкцію «years of experience».
explanation: Більшість помилок українськомовних кандидатів — це кальки: «досвід 3 роки» → *3 years experience* (правильно *three years of experience*), «вчу з січня» → *I am studying since* (правильно *I have been studying since*), «поясни мені» → *explain me* (правильно *explain to me*), «залежить від» → *depends of* (правильно *depends on*). Вивчи ці 8 конструкцій — і половина помилок зникне.
